kpis.name: ICT Systems have an active ATO
kpis.description: Share of in-scope ICT systems with an ATO number provided. A missing or blank ATO number is non-compliant. Systems are selected directly, or through infrastructure belonging to the selected managed networks; each system is counted once.
kpis.successMeasure: Target = 100% of ICT systems with active ATO.

kpis.name: ICT Systems are registered within DIIS
kpis.description: Share of in-scope ICT systems marked as registered in DIIS (DIIS Defined). Systems are selected directly, or through infrastructure belonging to the selected managed networks; each system is counted once.
kpis.successMeasure: Target = 100% of ICT systems registered within DIIS.
